The '''TIE/ca Punisher''', also known as the '''TIE Punisher''', '''TIE Interdictor''', '''TIE/it Interdictor starfighter''', or '''Advanced TIE Bomber''', was a heavy [[Bomber/Legends|bomber]] in service to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. 

==Characteristics==
[[File:RedlineXWM.png|thumb|left|250px|TIE Punisher pilot "Redline" firing homing missiles.]]

The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]] Punisher [[Bomber/Legends|bomber]] had wings and a command module which were nearly identical to those found on a [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bomber]] and [[TIE Heavy Bomber]]. However, the command module was flanked on both sides by a pair of ordnance pods, for a total of four.<ref name="SW:GB" /> They could also include enhanced sensors.<ref name="Punisher" />

The ship was [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by one individual, and was equipped with [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]], largely to ensure that their payload arrived at their destination. The armor was stronger than other TIE models, but the craft did not include a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]. The TIE Interdictor was armed with linked [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] and ordnance pods, able to carry 12 [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]], [[Homing missile/Legends|homing missiles]] or [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedos]]. The ship also had twin linked versions of the [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bomber's]] [[Proton bomb/Legends|proton bomb]] bays.<ref name="Target" /> Their ordnance could also be expanded to include [[Plasma torpedo/Legends|plasma torpedoes]], [[flechette torpedo]]es, [[advanced homing missile]]s, [[cluster mine]]s, and [[Ion bomb/Legends|ion bombs]].<ref name="Punisher" />

==History==
[[File:TIE_Punishers_XWM.png|thumb|left|250px|"Deathrain" leading a group of TIE Punishers on a bombing run.]]
The TIE Interdictor was used by the Empire during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SW:GB" /> The Interdictor was developed as an advanced TIE model following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The craft was to be used in assault missions where [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] could not venture, and earned an effective reputation as they hunted Rebel bases.<ref name="Target" /> "[[Redline]]" and "[["Deathrain"|Deathrain]]" both piloted TIE Interdictors at least once, and the Interdictor was also used for [[Cutlass Squadron]].<ref name="Punisher" />

Three of them attacked the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel's]] [[Great Temple/Legends|Massassi Station]] during the [[evacuation of Yavin]], although they were destroyed by concussive charges placed by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]].<ref name="SW:GB" />

During the [[Occupation of Bespin|attack]] on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]<ref name="SW:GB" /> in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> eight bombers were sent in as support units to occupy the city.<ref name="SW:GB" />

Several months later, at least one TIE Interdictor was still present along with other Imperial forces at a [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] Detention Center. The Detention Centers were subsequently [[Liberation of Kessel|liberated]] by [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] forces.<ref name="SW:GB" />

The TIE Interdictors continued to see use after at least 5.5 ABY, with the name "TIE Punisher", and included weaponry such as Flechette torpedoes.<ref name="Punisher" />

==Behind the scenes==
The TIE/IT first appeared in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''.

Three of them are provided to the player at the beginning of the Galactic Empire's [[Canon|non-canonical]] [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] mission.

The model's history was expanded upon in [[Fantasy Flight Games]] [[2014]] [[Roleplaying game]] sourcebook [[Stay on Target (sourcebook)|''Stay on Target'']], which introduced the "TIE/it" designation; however, all subsequent Fantasy Flight products abandoned this name in favor of the TIE/ca Punisher.
